items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Hank Crawford band was great. Howard Johnson was in the band, and Wendell Harrison from Detroit. We had…me and Marcus Belgrave on trumpets, and Hank

ctx.x: And how was the Hank Crawford band?

The Hank Crawford band was great. Howard Johnson was in the band, and Wendell Harrison from Detroit. We had…me and Marcus Belgrave on trumpets, and Hank and then it was just bass and drums. There was no piano or guitar or anything, and Hank would play piano sometimes. It was a great band and Hank wrote music for this small group.
